input: Find teen pre-college, leadership, counselor-in-training and career exploration summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Asheville, NC (every part of the city: downtown, West, North, South and East Asheville). Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Asheville summer 2026 teen pre college leadership counselor training
summer teen leadership CIT camps Hendersonville Brevard Black Mountain 2026
camp counselor training Brevard Keystone Illahee High Rocks

candidates.name: University of North Carolina Asheville
candidates.note: Weeklong residential pre-college programs explore academic fields and careers; also runs STEAM Studio summer camps.

candidates.name: Asheville-Buncombe Technical Community College
candidates.note: 2026 Allied Health camp offered hands-on labs and exploration of healthcare and veterinary careers.

candidates.name: Mountain Area Health Education Center (MAHEC)
candidates.note: Free four-day residential health-careers camp for rural high school students, held July 19–22, 2026.

candidates.name: Goodwill Industries of Northwest North Carolina
candidates.note: Two free weeklong 2026 camps introduced teens to medical careers and other local industries.

candidates.name: City of Asheville
candidates.note: CAYLA combines high school summer work placements with weekly leadership and career-exploration workshops; city also runs summer recreation camps.

candidates.name: Forest Floor Wilderness Programs
candidates.note: Teen counselor-in-training camp teaches nature mentoring, teaching and leadership; listed with its 2026 summer camps.

candidates.name: The Educational Garden Project
candidates.note: 2026 garden and nature camps include a counselor-in-training program for ages 11–16.

candidates.name: URJ 6 Points Sports Academy
candidates.note: Residential sports camp at Asheville School includes hands-on CIT leadership training; summer 2027 programs announced.

candidates.name: YMCA of Western North Carolina
candidates.note: Summer CILT day programs and Camp Watia residential leadership programs provide teen mentoring, service and leadership experience.

candidates.name: Montreat College
candidates.note: COMPASS academic and career immersion for rising high school sophomores through college freshmen; June 20–24, 2027 announced.

candidates.name: Carolinas Fellowship of Christian Athletes
candidates.note: July 6–10, 2026 leadership camp at YMCA Blue Ridge Assembly for middle and high school student-athletes.

candidates.name: Camp Rockmont
candidates.note: Boys' CIT and CIT2 programs combine outdoor activities with mentoring and leadership responsibilities; 2027 registration announced.

candidates.name: Western Carolina University
candidates.note: Catamount Engineering Experience offers rising grades 9–12 a three-day residential introduction to engineering and college life.

candidates.name: North Carolina School of Science and Mathematics
candidates.note: Summer Accelerator offers STEM enrichment and residential study; Morganton also hosted 2026 Early Accelerator day camps.

candidates.name: Blue Ridge Community College
candidates.note: 2026 Summer Academy offered elementary through high school students hands-on learning and skill exploration.

candidates.name: Haywood Community College
candidates.note: Bobcat College, June 15–19, 2026, offered rising grades 6–8 hands-on sessions with college instructors.

candidates.name: Isothermal Community College
candidates.note: 2026 Careers Electric Summer Electrical Academy provided career exploration; also lists engineering camp and a summer college bridge program.

candidates.name: McDowell County Schools
candidates.note: Camp Opportunity, partnered with McDowell Tech, introduces middle school students to a different career each day.

candidates.name: Camp Illahee
candidates.note: Girls' residential summer camp offers a counselor-in-training pathway for older campers.

candidates.name: Keystone Camp
candidates.note: Invitation-only high school leadership pathway progresses through leaders-in-training, aides and counselors-in-training.

candidates.name: Brevard Music Center
candidates.note: Summer institute includes advanced musical training for high school students ages 14 and older.

candidates.name: Kanuga Conferences
candidates.note: Runs Camp Kanuga and Camp Bob; Camp Kanuga's Leadership Academy develops older teens' leadership and counselor skills.

candidates.name: Blue Star Camps
candidates.note: Teen Village for rising grades 10–11 emphasizes camper leadership, mentoring younger campers and community service.

candidates.name: East Tennessee State University
candidates.note: 2026 offerings included Applied STEM career exploration, Rural High School Medical Camp and GattonRx pharmacy camp.

candidates.name: Tusculum University
candidates.note: Summer programs include skills camps, video-game business exploration and Upward Bound Summer Academy for high school students.

candidates.name: YMCA of Greenville
candidates.note: Camp Greenville leadership development for rising grades 10–12 teaches service, activity facilitation and camp staff skills.
